mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_user WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_article WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED') AS article_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) FROM blog_article) AS view_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(like_count), 0) FROM blog_article) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_comment WHERE status = 'APPROVED') AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_message_board WHERE status = 'APPROVED') AS message_count

SELECT (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS event_date, 'users' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS amount FROM blog_user WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= #{startDate} AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date < #{endDateExclusive} GROUP BY event_date
UNION ALL
SELECT (published_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS event_date, 'publishedArticles' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS amount FROM blog_article WHERE published_at IS NOT NULL AND (published_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= #{startDate} AND (published_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date < #{endDateExclusive} GROUP BY event_date
UNION ALL
SELECT (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS event_date, 'comments' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS amount FROM blog_comment WHERE status = 'APPROVED' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= #{startDate} AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date < #{endDateExclusive} GROUP BY event_date
UNION ALL
SELECT (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS event_date, 'messages' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS amount FROM blog_message_board WHERE status = 'APPROVED' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= #{startDate} AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date < #{endDateExclusive} GROUP BY event_date
UNION ALL
SELECT (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS event_date, 'likes' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS amount FROM blog_article_like WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= #{startDate} AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date < #{endDateExclusive} GROUP BY event_date
UNION ALL
SELECT stat_date AS event_date, 'views' AS metric, SUM(view_count) AS amount FROM blog_article_daily_stat WHERE stat_date >= #{startDate} AND stat_date < #{endDateExclusive} GROUP BY stat_date
ORDER BY event_date ASC, metric ASC
SELECT id, title, view_count, like_count, comment_count FROM blog_article WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY view_count DESC, id DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT id, title, view_count, like_count, comment_count FROM blog_article WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY like_count DESC, id DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT id, title, view_count, like_count, comment_count FROM blog_article WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY comment_count DESC, id DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(parent_category.id::text, 'OTHER') AS key, COALESCE(parent_category.name, '其他') AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM blog_article article LEFT JOIN blog_category child_category ON child_category.id = article.category_id AND child_category.level = 2 LEFT JOIN blog_category parent_category ON parent_category.id = child_category.parent_id AND parent_category.level = 1 WHERE article.status = 'PUBLISHED' GROUP BY parent_category.id, parent_category.name ORDER BY value DESC, key ASC
SELECT status AS key, status AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM blog_article GROUP BY status ORDER BY status ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN user_id IS NULL THEN 'VISITOR' ELSE 'USER' END AS key, CASE WHEN user_id IS NULL THEN '游客' ELSE '登录用户' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM blog_article_like GROUP BY CASE WHEN user_id IS NULL THEN 'VISITOR' ELSE 'USER' END, CASE WHEN user_id IS NULL THEN '游客' ELSE '登录用户' END ORDER BY key ASC
SELECT status AS key, status AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM blog_comment GROUP BY status ORDER BY status ASC
SELECT status AS key, status AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM blog_message_board GROUP BY status ORDER BY status ASC
